description: Front door not latching; tenant disclosed an ex-partner holds a key. Same-day lock change.

history.note: Emergency lock change raised. Tenant given 999 and National Domestic Abuse Helpline (0808 2000 247).
Escalated to Joanne Mills (safeguarding lead), P2. Record restricted: disclose nothing to anyone except Hannah on +447700900140.
New cylinder and latch fitted, 3 keys handed to tenant.
Key safe code changed; new code sent by SMS to +447700900140 only. Job completed.
